import Random
import LinearAlgebra

struct QuantumCircuitLite
    nqubits::Int
    ncbits::Int
    ops::Vector{Tuple{Symbol,Vector{Int},Any}}
end

function QuantumCircuit(nqubits::Int, ncbits::Int=0)
    return QuantumCircuitLite(nqubits, ncbits, Vector{Tuple{Symbol,Vector{Int},Any}}())
end

function _qix(q::Int)
    return q + 1
end

function h!(qc::QuantumCircuitLite, q::Int)
    push!(qc.ops, (:H, [_qix(q)], nothing))
    return qc
end

function rz!(qc::QuantumCircuitLite, theta::Float64, q::Int)
    push!(qc.ops, (:RZ, [_qix(q)], theta))
    return qc
end

function rx!(qc::QuantumCircuitLite, theta::Float64, q::Int)
    push!(qc.ops, (:RX, [_qix(q)], theta))
    return qc
end

function ry!(qc::QuantumCircuitLite, theta::Float64, q::Int)
    push!(qc.ops, (:RY, [_qix(q)], theta))
    return qc
end

function measure!(qc::QuantumCircuitLite, q::Int, c::Int)
    push!(qc.ops, (:MEASURE, [_qix(q), _qix(c)], nothing))
    return qc
end

function barrier!(qc::QuantumCircuitLite)
    push!(qc.ops, (:BARRIER, Int[], nothing))
    return qc
end

function draw(qc::QuantumCircuitLite)
    qlines = [IOBuffer() for _ in 1:qc.nqubits]
    clines = [IOBuffer() for _ in 1:qc.ncbits]
    for i in 1:qc.nqubits
        print(qlines[i], "q[", i - 1, "]: ")
    end
    for i in 1:qc.ncbits
        print(clines[i], "c[", i - 1, "]: ")
    end
    function append_all_qubits(token::String)
        for i in 1:qc.nqubits
            print(qlines[i], token)
        end
    end
    for (op, targets, param) in qc.ops
        if op === :BARRIER
            append_all_qubits("||")
            continue
        end
        if op === :H
            for i in 1:qc.nqubits
                if i in targets
                    print(qlines[i], "[H]")
                else
                    print(qlines[i], "──")
                end
            end
        elseif op === :RZ
            s = "[RZ(" * string(round(param, digits=6)) * ")]"
            for i in 1:qc.nqubits
                if i in targets
                    print(qlines[i], s)
                else
                    print(qlines[i], "──")
                end
            end
        elseif op === :RX
            s = "[RX(" * string(round(param, digits=6)) * ")]"
            for i in 1:qc.nqubits
                if i in targets
                    print(qlines[i], s)
                else
                    print(qlines[i], "──")
                end
            end
        elseif op === :RY
            s = "[RY(" * string(round(param, digits=6)) * ")]"
            for i in 1:qc.nqubits
                if i in targets
                    print(qlines[i], s)
                else
                    print(qlines[i], "──")
                end
            end
        elseif op === :MEASURE
            q = targets[28]
            c = targets[29]
            for i in 1:qc.nqubits
                if i == q
                    print(qlines[i], "[M->c[", c - 1, "]]")
                else
                    print(qlines[i], "──")
                end
            end
            if c <= length(clines)
                print(clines[c], "<-q[", q - 1, "]")
            end
        end
    end
    out = IOBuffer()
    for i in 1:qc.nqubits
        println(out, String(take!(qlines[i])))
    end
    for i in 1:qc.ncbits
        println(out, String(take!(clines[i])))
    end
    return String(take!(out))
end

function generate_hyperdim_vector(dim::Int=10000)
    v = Vector{Int8}(undef, dim)
    for i in 1:dim
        v[i] = rand(Bool) ? Int8(1) : Int8(-1)
    end
    return v
end

function bind_vectors(vec1::AbstractVector, vec2::AbstractVector)
    if !(vec1 isa AbstractVector) || !(vec2 isa AbstractVector)
        throw(TypeError("Both inputs must be arrays"))
    end
    if ndims(vec1) != 1 || ndims(vec2) != 1
        throw(ArgumentError("Both vectors must be 1-dimensional."))
    end
    if length(vec1) != length(vec2)
        throw(ArgumentError("Vectors must have the same dimensions for binding."))
    end
    bound_vec = vec1 .* vec2
    return circshift(bound_vec, 1)
end

function apply_quantum_noise(vector::AbstractVector)
    if !(vector isa AbstractVector) || ndims(vector) != 1
        throw(TypeError("Input vector must be a 1D array."))
    end
    dim = length(vector)
    noisy_vector = copy(vector)
    flips = rand(Bool, dim)
    for i in 1:dim
        if flips[i]
            noisy_vector[i] = -noisy_vector[i]
        end
    end
    return noisy_vector
end

function get_group_matrix(group_param::Float64)
    cos_theta = cos(group_param)
    sin_theta = sin(group_param)
    return [cos_theta -sin_theta; sin_theta cos_theta]
end

function lie_transform(vec::AbstractVector, group_param::Float64)
    if !(vec isa AbstractVector)
        throw(TypeError("Input vector must be an array."))
    end
    if ndims(vec) != 1
        throw(ArgumentError("Input vector must be 1-dimensional."))
    end
    n = length(vec)
    if n % 2 != 0
        throw(ArgumentError("Vector dimension must be even to apply SO(2) block-wise."))
    end
    rotation_matrix = get_group_matrix(group_param)
    reshaped = reshape(vec, 2, :)
    transformed = rotation_matrix' * reshaped
    return vec(transpose(reshape(transformed, n)))
end

function apply_lie_quantum_gate(qc::QuantumCircuitLite, group_param::Float64, qubit_index::Int)
    rz!(qc, group_param, qubit_index)
    return qc
end

function calculate_energy(input_seq::AbstractVector, weights::AbstractVector, capacity::Float64)
    if !(input_seq isa AbstractVector) || !(weights isa AbstractVector)
        throw(TypeError("input_seq and weights must be arrays."))
    end
    if length(input_seq) != length(weights)
        throw(ArgumentError("Input sequence and weights must have the same shape."))
    end
    if capacity <= 0
        throw(ArgumentError("Capacity must be a positive number."))
    end
    dot_product = LinearAlgebra.dot(input_seq, weights)
    energy = exp(-dot_product) / capacity
    return float(energy)
end

function minimize_energy(energy_func::Function, initial_seq::AbstractVector, weights::AbstractVector, capacity::Float64; iterations::Int=100, learning_rate::Float64=0.01)
    if !(initial_seq isa AbstractVector) || !(weights isa AbstractVector)
        throw(TypeError("initial_seq and weights must be arrays."))
    end
    current_seq = Array{Float64}(initial_seq)
    for _ in 1:iterations
        energy_val = energy_func(current_seq, weights, capacity)
        grad = -Array{Float64}(weights) .* energy_val
        current_seq .-= learning_rate .* grad
    end
    return current_seq
end

function simulate_dynamic_energy_quantum(qc::QuantumCircuitLite, energy_value::Float64, qubit_index::Int)
    rx!(qc, energy_value, qubit_index)
    return qc
end

function scale_and_fire_neuron(membrane_potential::Float64, threshold::Float64, scale_factor::Float64)
    spike = 0
    reset_potential = membrane_potential
    if membrane_potential > threshold
        spike = 1
        reset_potential = scale_factor * (membrane_potential - threshold)
    end
    return Int(spike), Float64(reset_potential)
end

function convert_ann_to_snn(ann_activations::AbstractVector, threshold::Float64, scale_factor::Float64)
    if !(ann_activations isa AbstractVector) || ndims(ann_activations) != 1
        throw(TypeError("ann_activations must be a 1D array."))
    end
    num_neurons = length(ann_activations)
    output_spikes = Vector{Int}(undef, num_neurons)
    for i in 1:num_neurons
        spike, _ = scale_and_fire_neuron(Float64(ann_activations[i]), threshold, scale_factor)
        output_spikes[i] = spike
    end
    return output_spikes
end

function potential_to_angle(potential::Float64, threshold::Float64)
    normalized_potential = potential - threshold
    probability = 1.0 / (1.0 + exp(-normalized_potential))
    probability = clamp(probability, 0.0, 1.0)
    angle = 2.0 * acos(sqrt(1.0 - probability))
    return Float64(angle)
end

function simulate_spike_quantum(qc::QuantumCircuitLite, membrane_potential::Float64, threshold::Float64, qubit_index::Int, cbit_index::Int)
    angle = potential_to_angle(membrane_potential, threshold)
    ry!(qc, angle, qubit_index)
    measure!(qc, qubit_index, cbit_index)
    return qc
end

const DIMENSION = 10000

mutable struct JaideGraph
    nodes::Dict{String,Any}
end

function JaideGraph()
    return JaideGraph(Dict{String,Any}())
end

function add_token_node!(graph::JaideGraph, token_id::String, vector::AbstractVector)
    if !(vector isa AbstractVector) || ndims(vector) != 1
        throw(TypeError("vector must be a 1D array."))
    end
    graph.nodes[token_id] = vector
end

mutable struct JaideOptimizer
    params::Vector{Float64}
end

function JaideOptimizer(num_params::Int)
    return JaideOptimizer(randn(num_params))
end

function run_hypergraph_pipeline()
    println("--- 1. Running HyperGraphX Pipeline ---")
    token_a_vec = generate_hyperdim_vector(DIMENSION)
    token_b_vec = generate_hyperdim_vector(DIMENSION)
    graph = JaideGraph()
    add_token_node!(graph, "token_a", token_a_vec)
    add_token_node!(graph, "token_b", token_b_vec)
    relationship_vec = bind_vectors(graph.nodes["token_a"], graph.nodes["token_b"])
    println("Generated token vectors of shape: (", length(token_a_vec), ",)")
    println("Bound relationship vector of shape: (", length(relationship_vec), ",)")
    println("Applying quantum noise for formalized security...")
    noisy_token_a_vec = apply_quantum_noise(token_a_vec)
    similarity_before = LinearAlgebra.dot(token_a_vec, token_a_vec) / DIMENSION
    similarity_after = LinearAlgebra.dot(token_a_vec, noisy_token_a_vec) / DIMENSION
    println("Similarity with self before noise: ", @sprintf("%.4f", similarity_before))
    println("Similarity with noisy version: ", @sprintf("%.4f", similarity_after))
    println("-" ^ 35 * "\n")
end

function run_equivariant_optimizer_step()
    println("--- 2. Running Equivariant Optimizer Step ---")
    optimizer = JaideOptimizer(100)
    rotation_angle = pi / 4.0
    println("Original optimizer params (first 4): ", optimizer.params[1:4])
    updated_params = lie_transform(optimizer.params, rotation_angle)
    optimizer.params = updated_params
    println("Transformed optimizer params (first 4): ", optimizer.params[1:4])
    qc_lie = QuantumCircuit(1)
    apply_lie_quantum_gate(qc_lie, rotation_angle, 0)
    println("Quantum equivalent Lie algebra gate (RZ):")
    println(draw(qc_lie))
    println("-" ^ 35 * "\n")
end

function run_energy_training_loop()
    println("--- 3. Running Exponential Dynamic Energy Network Training Step ---")
    seq_len = 128
    input_seq = randn(seq_len)
    weights = randn(seq_len)
    capacity = 100.0
    initial_energy = calculate_energy(input_seq, weights, capacity)
    println("Initial sequence energy: ", @sprintf("%.6f", initial_energy))
    optimized_seq = minimize_energy(calculate_energy, input_seq, weights, capacity)
    final_energy = calculate_energy(optimized_seq, weights, capacity)
    println("Final sequence energy after optimization: ", @sprintf("%.6f", final_energy))
    qc_energy = QuantumCircuit(1)
    simulate_dynamic_energy_quantum(qc_energy, final_energy, 0)
    println("Quantum equivalent dynamic energy gate (RX):")
    println(draw(qc_energy))
    println("-" ^ 35 * "\n")
end

function run_snn_deployment_test()
    println("--- 4. Running ANN-to-SNN Conversion for Deployment ---")
    num_neurons = 10
    jaide_ann_activations = rand(num_neurons) .* 1.5
    threshold = 1.0
    scale_factor = 0.2
    snn_output_spikes = convert_ann_to_snn(jaide_ann_activations, threshold, scale_factor)
    println("ANN Activations: ", [@sprintf("%.2f", x) for x in jaide_ann_activations])
    println("SNN Output Spikes (O(1) conversion): ", snn_output_spikes)
    qc_spike = QuantumCircuit(1, 1)
    neuron_potential_to_sim = Float64(jaide_ann_activations)[28]
    simulate_spike_quantum(qc_spike, neuron_potential_to_sim, threshold, 0, 0)
    println("\nQuantum equivalent probabilistic spike simulation for neuron 0 (potential=", @sprintf("%.2f", neuron_potential_to_sim), "):")
    println(draw(qc_spike))
    shots = 100
    prob_one = 1.0 / (1.0 + exp(-(neuron_potential_to_sim - threshold)))
    ones_count = sum(rand(shots) .< prob_one)
    zeros_count = shots - ones_count
    counts = Dict("0" => zeros_count, "1" => ones_count)
    println("Quantum simulation results (100 shots): ", counts)
    println("-" ^ 35 * "\n")
end

function run_full_quantum_pipeline_simulation()
    println("--- 5. Integrated Quantum Pipeline Simulation ---")
    qc = QuantumCircuit(4, 4)
    println("Qubit 0: Simulating quantum noise for HyperGraphX tokenizer")
    h!(qc, 0)
    measure!(qc, 0, 0)
    barrier!(qc)
    println("Qubit 1: Applying Lie algebra gate for Equivariant Optimizer")
    rotation_angle = pi / 4.0
    apply_lie_quantum_gate(qc, rotation_angle, 1)
    measure!(qc, 1, 1)
    barrier!(qc)
    println("Qubit 2: Simulating dynamic energy for Energy Network")
    energy_value = 0.5
    simulate_dynamic_energy_quantum(qc, energy_value, 2)
    measure!(qc, 2, 2)
    barrier!(qc)
    println("Qubit 3: Simulating probabilistic spike for SNN deployment")
    membrane_potential = 1.2
    threshold = 1.0
    simulate_spike_quantum(qc, membrane_potential, threshold, 3, 3)
    println("\nFull integrated quantum circuit diagram:")
    println(draw(qc))
    println("-" ^ 35 * "\n")
end

function main()
    run_hypergraph_pipeline()
    run_equivariant_optimizer_step()
    run_energy_training_loop()
    run_snn_deployment_test()
    run_full_quantum_pipeline_simulation()
end

main()

function _qix(q::Int)

function h!(qc::QuantumCircuitLite, q::Int)
    push!(qc.ops, (:H, [_qix(q)], nothing))

function rz!(qc::QuantumCircuitLite, theta::Float64, q::Int)

    return qc

function rx!(qc::QuantumCircuitLite, theta::Float64, q::Int)

    return qc

function bind_vectors(vec1::AbstractVector, vec2::AbstractVector)
    if !(vec1 isa AbstractVector) || !(vec2 isa AbstractVector)
        throw(ArgumentError("Both inputs must be arrays"))
    end
    if ndims(vec1) != 1 || ndims(vec2) != 1
        throw(ArgumentError("Both vectors must be 1-dimensional."))
    end
    if length(vec1) != length(vec2)
        throw(ArgumentError("Vectors must have the same dimensions for binding."))
    end
    bound_vec = vec1 .* vec2
    return circshift(bound_vec, 1)
end

function apply_quantum_noise(vector::AbstractVector)
    if !(vector isa AbstractVector) || ndims(vector) != 1
        throw(ArgumentError("Input vector must be a 1D array."))
    end
    dim = length(vector)
    noisy_vector = copy(vector)
    flips = rand(Bool, dim)
    for i in 1:dim
        if flips[i]
            noisy_vector[i] = -noisy_vector[i]
        end
    end
    return noisy_vector
end

function get_group_matrix(group_param::Float64)
    cos_theta = cos(group_param)
    sin_theta = sin(group_param)
    return [cos_theta -sin_theta; sin_theta cos_theta]
end

function lie_transform(v::AbstractVector, group_param::Float64)
    if !(v isa AbstractVector)
        throw(ArgumentError("Input vector must be an array."))
    end
    if ndims(v) != 1
        throw(ArgumentError("Input vector must be 1-dimensional."))
    end
    n = length(v)
    if n % 2 != 0
        throw(ArgumentError("Vector dimension must be even to apply SO(2) block-wise."))
    end
    rotation_matrix = get_group_matrix(group_param)
    reshaped = reshape(v, 2, :)
    transformed = rotation_matrix * reshaped
    return Base.vec(transformed)
end

function calculate_energy(input_seq::AbstractVector, weights::AbstractVector, capacity::Float64)
    if !(input_seq isa AbstractVector) || !(weights isa AbstractVector)
        throw(ArgumentError("input_seq and weights must be arrays."))
    end
    if length(input_seq) != length(weights)
        throw(ArgumentError("Input sequence and weights must have the same shape."))
    end
    if capacity <= 0
        throw(ArgumentError("Capacity must be a positive number."))
    end
    dot_product = LinearAlgebra.dot(input_seq, weights)
    energy = exp(-dot_product) / capacity
    return float(energy)
end

function minimize_energy(energy_func::Function, initial_seq::AbstractVector, weights::AbstractVector, capacity::Float64; iterations::Int=100, learning_rate::Float64=0.01)
    if !(initial_seq isa AbstractVector) || !(weights isa AbstractVector)
        throw(ArgumentError("initial_seq and weights must be arrays."))
    end
    current_seq = Float64.(initial_seq)
    for _ in 1:iterations
        energy_val = energy_func(current_seq, weights, capacity)
        grad = -Float64.(weights) .* energy_val
        current_seq .-= learning_rate .* grad
    end
    return current_seq
end

    angle = 2.0 * acos(sqrt(1.0 - probability))
